executive_summary: The infrastructure has a low risk posture with no immediate threats. The main concern is the lack of detailed utilization and health data for servers, which could obscure potential issues over time.

predicted_failures.description: The network device (router/firewall) lacks redundancy, increasing the risk of a single point of failure.

root_causes.description: The network device is configured in an active-passive HA mode but lacks detailed redundancy and failover testing.

preventive_measures.action: Implement active-active HA configuration for the network device.
preventive_measures.rationale: This will ensure that there is no single point of failure and services remain available during failover scenarios.
